The '''Zephyr Light Combat Fighter''' was a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] produced by [[Mestapol]]. [[Vohrkrewel Yahrkar]] owned a Zephyr Light Combat Fighter named the ''[[Blood Hawk]]''.<ref name="RightPlace" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Zephyr Light Combat Fighter appears in [[West End Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] book ''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''. ''[[Classic Adventures]]'', which includes a reprint of ''The Politics of Contraband'', misspells it as "Zephy''e''r".
